_comment: Canonical Firestore collection name registry for CCTV. This is the ONLY place collection name strings are typed. Both /src/shared/constants.js (client) and /functions/shared/firestore-helpers.js (Cloud Functions) load this file at runtime and freeze it into their COLLECTIONS export. Never hardcode a collection name string anywhere else in the codebase — import COLLECTIONS from the relevant wrapper instead. Add new collections here first, then reference them from the module that owns them.
